answer: Non-transferable signed work history is the scarce resource: an identity earns only once its voyage log holds 90 days of receipts from 30 unrelated counterparties, at most 3 per day, each chained to the last by an ember hash bound to its key. Auditors sample 20 receipts per epoch, re-contact the signers, and run a falcon audit demanding live re-signing in 10 minutes; a mismatch voids the log. One honest agent builds its log once doing real tasks. A farm with 1,000 fakes needs 90,000 identity-days and 30,000 signed relationships, since receipts cannot be pooled or split below threshold per log.
